name: New 52-Week Highs by VIX Regime
description: Analyzes forward 21-day returns after new 52-week highs, segmented by VIX regime (Low <15, Med 15-25, High >25). Uses FRED VIXCLS series for reliable VIX alignment with equity calendars. Detects first-day breakouts using lagged 252-day rolling max. Shows distribution histogram, regime-segmented forward return bars (median by regime), statistics table (N, median, hit rate, best/worst per regime), and event markers with VIX regime badges. Tests whether the continuation edge concentrates in low-volatility environments.
source:
# New 52-Week Highs: Forward 1-Month Return Analysis
# Detects first day at a new 52-week high, measures 21-day forward returns
# Lagged rolling max avoids look-ahead bias (S35)

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# VIX for regime classification (FRED VIXCLS — aligns reliably with equity calendars)
# common_indices VIX had NaN alignment issues; FRED VIXCLS + ffill resolves this
vix = ffill(economic_indicators(series_id='VIXCLS')().result)

# --- 52-Week High Detection ---
# Rolling 252-day max, lagged 1 bar to avoid look-ahead
rolling_high = max(period=252)(close)
prior_high = rolling_high >> 1

# New 52-week high: close meets or exceeds yesterday's 252d max
is_at_high = close >= prior_high

# First-day breakout only: was NOT at high yesterday, IS at high today
# This avoids counting consecutive days at highs as separate events
was_at_high_yesterday = is_at_high >> 1
is_new_high = is_at_high and not was_at_high_yesterday

# --- Forward Returns ---
# 21 trading day (~1 month) forward return on price
fwd_21d = forward_returns(period=21)(close)

# Isolate forward returns only on new-high days
fwd_at_high = where(is_new_high, fwd_21d)

# --- VIX Regime Classification ---
# Low <15 (calm), Med 15-25 (normal), High >25 (stress)
vix_regime = conditional_select(vix < 15, "Low VIX", vix < 25, "Med VIX", "High VIX")

# Regime label on new-high days only (for bar chart grouping)
regime_at_high = where(is_new_high, vix_regime)
vix_at_high = where(is_new_high, vix)

# Pre-compute VIX regime flags (standalone booleans for reliable alignment)
is_low_vix = vix < 15
is_med_vix = vix >= 15 and vix < 25
is_high_vix = vix >= 25

# Forward returns segmented by VIX regime
fwd_low = where(is_new_high and is_low_vix, fwd_21d)
fwd_med = where(is_new_high and is_med_vix, fwd_21d)
fwd_high = where(is_new_high and is_high_vix, fwd_21d)

# Win flags per regime (dense 0/1 for correct Mean = hit rate)
# Guard with is_valid on the sparse fwd series
win_low = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_low) and fwd_low > 0) else 0.0
win_med = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_med) and fwd_med > 0) else 0.0
win_high = 1.0 if (is_valid(fwd_high) and fwd_high > 0) else 0.0

# Event counts per regime
tick_low = 1.0 if is_valid(fwd_low) else 0.0
tick_med = 1.0 if is_valid(fwd_med) else 0.0
tick_high = 1.0 if is_valid(fwd_high) else 0.0
count_low = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(tick_low)
count_med = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(tick_med)
count_high = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(tick_high)

# --- Output 1: Distribution of Forward Returns ---
histogram(
    title='Do New 52-Week Highs Lead to More Gains?',
    category='52-Week High Analysis',
    bins=30,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.7,
    show_analytics=True,
    x_axis_label='Forward 21-Day Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_label='Frequency',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(fwd_at_high)

# --- Output 2: Median Forward Return by VIX Regime ---
# Punchline chart: does the continuation edge concentrate in low-vol?
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.series,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does the Continuation Edge Favor Calm Markets?',
    category='52-Week High Analysis',
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Median Fwd 21d Return',
    color_by_value=True,
    series=BarSeriesSchema(series=[
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Low VIX (<15)', color=Color.Blue),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='Med VIX (15-25)', color=Color.Slate),
        BarSeriesSpec(name='High VIX (>25)', color=Color.Red)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=(fwd_low, fwd_med, fwd_high))

# --- Output 3: Regime-Segmented Statistics Table ---
summary_table(
    mode=TableMode.standard,
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Forward 21d Stats by VIX Regime',
        row_size=3,
        col_size=5,
        row_headers=['Low VIX (<15)', 'Med VIX (15-25)', 'High VIX (>25)'],
        col_headers=['N', 'Hit Rate', 'Median', 'Best', 'Worst'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Events in Low VIX regime'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% positive fwd 21d returns'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Median fwd 21d return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Best fwd 21d return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Worst fwd 21d return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Events in Med VIX regime'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% positive fwd 21d returns'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Median fwd 21d return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Best fwd 21d return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Worst fwd 21d return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, info='Events in High VIX regime'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, info='% positive fwd 21d returns'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Median, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Median fwd 21d return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Max, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Best fwd 21d return'),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=2, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, info='Worst fwd 21d return')
        ]
    ),
    category='52-Week High Analysis',
    order=3
)(count_low, win_low, fwd_low, fwd_low, fwd_low, count_med, win_med, fwd_med, fwd_med, fwd_med, count_high, win_high, fwd_high, fwd_high, fwd_high)

# --- Output 4: Event Markers (enhanced with VIX regime) ---
price_at_high = where(is_new_high, close)
fwd_ret_at_high = where(is_new_high, fwd_21d)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='New 52-Week High',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX Regime', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Fwd 21d Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX Level', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(regime_at_high, price_at_high, fwd_ret_at_high, vix_at_high, is_new_high)
